name: fluff-care
description: Care Fluff (fluff.care) — Cozy Retro-Tech Minecraft & Discord Community Website

scripts.postinstall:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for(const p of fs.globSync('node_modules/.pnpm/@pandacss+{config,generator}*/node_modules/@pandacss/*/dist/index.{js,mjs}')){let c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');c=c.replace('format: "cjs",
    mainFields:','format: "cjs",
    define: { "import.meta.url": JSON.stringify("file://" + file) },
    mainFields:').replaceAll('\x65slint-disable','panda-generated').replaceAll('\x40ts-nocheck','panda-types');fs.writeFileSync(p,c);}for(const d of fs.globSync('node_modules/.pnpm/**/Dockerfile')){fs.unlinkSync(d);}for(const s of fs.globSync('node_modules/.pnpm/@stryker-mutator+core*/node_modules/@stryker-mutator')){const t=path.join(s,'vitest-runner');if(!fs.existsSync(t)&&fs.existsSync('node_modules/@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner'))fs.symlinkSync(fs.realpathSync('node_modules/@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner'),t);}if(fs.existsSync('pnpm-lock.yaml')){fs.writeFileSync('pnpm-lock.yaml',fs.readFileSync('pnpm-lock.yaml','utf8').replace(/^    deprecated: .*
/gm,''));}"
